  • 発売日: 2002-09-06
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: ぱちFile
  • 英語名: Pachi File

あらすじ

Here are the games included in this fun disc:

“Cosmic Man Episode 9”

This is the never-released episode of “Cosmic Man,” released in October 2001. Because of the controversial title “co*c” and some other reasons, it couldn’t be included in the original game. All the details of the story haven’t been revealed yet, but it seems you’ll be able to see four girls having sex…!

item.description:

  • 発売日: 2002-07-05
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: サイキッカー美々
  • 英語名: Psychicer Mimi

あらすじ

Main character is a genius young man. One day he has his psychic powers awoken in front of a female classmate. She agrees to help him train these powers with a series of exercises, but others think of them as usual lovers. Strange incidents start to happen at school - is it possible to investigate them with newly acquired powers?

item.title: Cosmic Man
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Soubi Kenkyuujo
  • 発売日: 2001-10-12
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: コズミックマン
  • 英語名: Cosmic Man

あらすじ

A mysterious space creature, ‘The Cosmic Man,’ tries to save the earth from bad space monsters. In the year 21XX, Bad monsters from space threaten our peaceful life on earth. The Cosmic Man suddenly appears and beats the monsters. Cooperating with the earth defense organization, ‘CAT (Cancer Attack Team)’, Cosmic Man begins to get rid of the damage. People start to see the fighting Cosmic Man and space monsters on a daily basis.

item.title: Himera
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Soubi Kenkyuujo
  • 発売日: 2001-04-27
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 姫裸
  • 英語名: Himera

别名

  • 姫裸（ヒメラ）

あらすじ

Duran was one of the knights who had pledged his allegiance to the king. However, the king betrayed them all. They were disgraced and then completely destroyed. Our hero vows revenge and roams the country reeking havoc as a black knight.

Duran and his vagabonds creep into the city one night and kidnap the king’s daughter and maid in waiting. They confine the two girls in their hideout, where they rape and disgrace the two in innumerous ways.
